name: ICMP Error Message Echoing Integrity Probe
description: Typical severity: Low. Likelihood of attack: Medium. An adversary uses a technique to generate an ICMP Error message (Port Unreachable, Destination Unreachable, Redirect, Source Quench, Time Exceeded, Parameter Problem) from a target and then analyze the integrity of data returned or "Quoted" from the originating request that generated the error message.
